workflow.name: Hospital reception
workflow.description: A synthetic case-level reception workflow: explicit screening, ticket issue/call, identity and affiliation evidence, owned encounter, observations, professional release, payment policy, dispatcher choice, atomic capacity reservation and receiving acceptance. An emergency signal interrupts any active routine task, cancels the case ticket and releases its reservation before awaiting ECU acceptance. Numeric queue sequence is configured per experiment; independent runs do not share a global facility priority queue.
workflow.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Entry route
package.description: Routes explicit assessment facts to awaitAssessment, routine or emergency. This synthetic decision does not diagnose, authenticate actors or implement a human workflow.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Classify explicit lookup result
package.description: Distinguishes confirmed zero/one/many matches from unavailable or invalid lookup results. No lookup or identity verification is performed.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Classify affiliation evidence
package.description: Only explicit verified or confirmedNone evidence permits routine continuation. Unknown, unavailable, expired and contradictory evidence remains unresolved; absence is never inferred.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Record professional review disposition
package.description: Release requires an explicit authorized response tied to the current assessment. An emergency disposition takes precedence over ordinary release. This decision performs no clinical assessment or treatment.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

tests.name: Old assessment cannot clear new review

package.name: Interpret explicit payment policy
package.description: Consumes an explicit policy disposition. Allow, defer and waive permit routine continuation; review, error and unknown values require review. It does not charge money, infer coverage or block emergency routing.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Check explicit candidate eligibility
package.description: Combines explicit authority-supplied facility/service/qualification/duty facts and positive capacity. The result is only a proposal; the capacity owner must reserve atomically.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Validate a human dispatcher choice
package.description: A dispatcher explicitly selects candidateA or candidateB. Only an eligible selected candidate advances to atomic reservation. No candidate is silently chosen when neither is eligible.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Read typed candidate eligibility
package.description: Reads exact adapter facts and checks the configured resource identity before reusing the scalar eligibility decision.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

machine.name: Case-scoped ticket lifecycle
machine.description: Owns one case's durable ticket, call and cancellation facts. Ticket IDs are derived from an explicitly unique case ID; A configured starting sequence supplies the numeric display ticket; this one-case experiment does not share a facility queue across independent runs. Printing and human attendance remain explicit tasks.
machine.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Issue or reuse case ticket
package.description: Proposes one case-derived ticket; another case cannot take ownership of an existing ticket.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: call case ticket
package.description: Checks case ownership and existing ticket before changing a durable lifecycle flag.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: cancel case ticket
package.description: Checks case ownership and existing ticket before changing a durable lifecycle flag.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

machine.name: Case-scoped encounter identity
machine.description: Owns one explicit case/patient association and stable encounter reference. Distinct case IDs produce distinct encounter IDs even when the patient is the same. This is modeled ownership, not a patient registry or live clinical database.
machine.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Open or reuse case encounter
package.description: Requires named case and patient, and prevents another case/patient pair from replacing an already owned encounter.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

machine.name: Single-slot assignment owner
machine.description: Atomic durable reservation, receiving acceptance and release for one resource slot. Separate owners can model separate clinicians, desks or devices. Capacity starts at zero or one; serialized commands and exact receipts model races without claiming distributed production transactions.
machine.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: reserve one owned resource slot
package.description: Checks exact resource/case ownership. Reserve consumes one available slot atomically; release restores it only for its holder; accept records the receiving party's separately supplied acceptance.
package.author: LCE Studio contributors

task.title: Initial emergency screening
task.instructions: Record explicit initial screening. This form does not assess or diagnose the patient. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Call numeric ticket
task.instructions: Call the displayed queue number and explicitly confirm attendance. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Query identity registry
task.instructions: Supply completed=false on lookup failure, even when matchCount=0. Only a completed zero-match lookup permits registration. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Register new patient
task.instructions: Create a named patient only after confirmed zero-match lookup; return confirmed=false on registration failure. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Confirm existing patient identity
task.instructions: Explicitly confirm the candidate identity; no demographic merge is automatic. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Review unresolved identity
task.instructions: Resolve unavailable, ambiguous or unconfirmed identity explicitly. confirmed=false remains in review. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Query affiliation evidence
task.instructions: Use verified or confirmedNone only with explicit evidence. unknown, unavailable, expired and contradictory require review. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Review unresolved affiliation
task.instructions: Use verified or confirmedNone only with explicit evidence. unknown, unavailable, expired and contradictory require review. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Record observations and vitals
task.instructions: Record whether observations are accepted and supply their reference. Missing observations remain unresolved; feverAlert is an explicit professional observation, not a diagnostic threshold calculated here. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Review missing or invalid observations
task.instructions: Record whether observations are accepted and supply their reference. Missing observations remain unresolved; feverAlert is an explicit professional observation, not a diagnostic threshold calculated here. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Clinician fever assessment and release
task.instructions: A professional explicitly supplies released, review or emergency. Release must be authorized and tied to the current assessment reference; no automatic clinical clearance is inferred. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Clinician review and release
task.instructions: A professional explicitly supplies released, review or emergency. Release must be authorized and tied to the current assessment reference; no automatic clinical clearance is inferred. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Evaluate payment policy
task.instructions: Supply explicit allow, defer or waive to continue; review, policyError or unknown remain in review. Emergency interrupts bypass this task. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Review financing policy
task.instructions: Supply explicit allow, defer or waive to continue; review, policyError or unknown remain in review. Emergency interrupts bypass this task. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Read workforce availability
task.instructions: Return explicit candidate facts for providerA and providerB. Snapshot availability is only a proposal; the owned slot command is the final atomic gate. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Dispatcher selects eligible doctor
task.instructions: Explicitly select candidateA, candidateB or wait. Selection does not reserve capacity. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Wait or reselect doctor
task.instructions: No assignment has completed. Explicitly request another availability check; the emergency signal remains available. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Physician accepts consultation
task.instructions: Receiving clinician explicitly accepts this case and selected resource. A reservation alone is not receiving acceptance. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.

task.title: Emergency unit receiving acceptance
task.instructions: Explicit receiving-unit acceptance is required. accepted=false keeps emergency handoff pending. Supply the current case, receiving unit, emergency encounter and handoff reference. Responses are explicit synthetic fixtures; actorRef and evidenceRef record their supplied provenance. No live integration is performed.
